en.eyebrow: FOR INVESTORS WHO MANAGE STOCKS & OPTIONS
en.title:
See what your stock
and options trades
actually earned.
en.intro: Your broker lists transactions and positions. TAD connects related records so you can review gains, losses and capital use across accounts, stocks and strategies.
en.audience: Built for investors who already piece together broker screens and spreadsheets to understand their trades.
en.privacy_title: Your broker data stays on your computer.
en.privacy: Import, save and analyze locally. The current TAD app does not upload your broker files or account data to a TAD cloud service.
en.privacy_detail: The interface's Upload action sends files to the app on your computer. Information you choose to share through feedback, email or another service is a separate action.
en.short_cta: Download the Mac technical preview or request a demo.
questions: How do the trades add up?
How much, and for how long?
en.p2_title:
Find the contributors.
Then follow the trades.
en.p2_intro: Start with the result that matters to you. Compare strategy contributions or bring a stock and its related options into one review.
en.strategy_body: Compare stock and option contributions, including supported LEAPS and CC. Explore PMCC support through long-Call and short-Call records. Confirmed relationships and complete strategy returns depend on the available evidence.
en.stock_body: Bring stock transactions and related options together. Find open holdings and closed trades, then inspect the gains, losses and costs behind each result.
en.scope_title: A call premium is only part of the story.
en.scope_body: A stock or long Call can lose more than the short Call earns. Read the supporting asset alongside the short leg; some strategy results remain partial. TAD marks those gaps beside the analysis.
en.p3_title:
Follow each trade,
from entry onward.
en.p3_intro: Follow open, partly closed and closed trades. See recorded entry costs, dates, remaining holdings and realized results where the records support them.
measures: Separate realized results from unrealized P/L at the displayed saved price and date. Prices are saved observations, not live quotes.
Check the included legs, period and cost basis. A whole-trade return needs a complete lifecycle and sufficient cost evidence.
Check which trades and dates each capital-use or efficiency figure covers. A matched subset is not an account return, and short-Call income is not the complete CC or PMCC return.
en.p4_title:
Bring your questions.
Start with the samples.
en.p4_intro: Download the Mac preview with synthetic broker files and bilingual guides. No Git, Python, Node, model account or API key is required. You can also request a demo.
en.support_title: Broker files, with a defined scope
en.support_body: Specific USD CSV layouts from Moomoo, Chase / J.P. Morgan investment accounts and E*TRADE. Compatibility depends on the report and available history. Ordinary statement upload archives PDFs; it does not extract or reconcile their contents.
en.platform_title: Mac preview, not yet broadly verified
en.platform_body: Planned: Apple Silicon M1+ and release macOS 15 / 26 / 27. Verified: development Mac on macOS 15.2, including independent same-Mac review. Test-user Macs remain unverified. Ad-hoc signed; NOT notarized. Do not disable system protections to run it.
en.personal: Begin with synthetic samples. After those checks pass, use the online guide for optional personal-data evaluation in a separate fresh environment. Keep account details and broker originals out of public feedback.
en.not_yet: Not yet available: Windows, a generic import template, general PDF extraction, live quotes or knowledge-based trade-management guidance.
en.highlights_title: A working product. An AI development case study.
highlights: Designed stock and options review workflows covering strategy contributions, per-stock P&L, trading costs, and capital efficiency.
Designed extensible, layered data models with user review and traceable corrections to improve data quality and support additional brokers and analyses.
Built and iterated the application, coordinating specialized AI agents for implementation, code review, testing, and release.
en.terms: Under development; planned proprietary shareware. Pricing and future terms are not announced. Application source remains private. Preview use follows the Release evaluation notice; this presentation grants no application license.
en.screen_note: Actual current-release UI. Wholly synthetic demonstration data.

zh.eyebrow: 为自己管理股票与期权的投资者而设计
zh.title:
看清股票和期权交易，
到底赚了多少。
zh.intro: 券商列出了成交与持仓，但相关交易的结果仍不容易看清。TAD 把记录连接起来，帮助你按账户、个股和策略复盘盈亏与资金使用。
zh.audience: 适合已经在券商页面和表格之间来回整理、想弄清自己交易结果的投资者。
zh.privacy_title: 券商数据留在你的电脑上。
zh.privacy: 在本机导入、保存和分析。当前 TAD 本地应用不会把券商文件或账户数据上传到 TAD 云端。
zh.privacy_detail: 界面中的“上传”是把文件交给本机运行的程序；你自行通过反馈、邮件或其他服务分享信息，是另外的动作。
zh.short_cta: 可下载 Mac 公开技术预览，也可申请演示。
zh.p2_title:
找到收益来源，
再看背后的交易。
zh.p2_intro: 从你关心的结果出发：比较不同策略的贡献，或把一只股票与相关期权放在一起复盘。
zh.strategy_body: 比较股票与期权的收益贡献，包括有记录依据的 LEAPS 和 CC。联系长期 Call 与短 Call，查看 PMCC 支撑情况；关系确认和完整策略回报取决于现有依据。
zh.stock_body: 联系股票交易和相关期权，找到仍在持仓与已经平仓的交易，进一步查看各项结果背后的盈利、亏损和成本。
zh.scope_title: 收到 Call 权利金，只是故事的一部分。
zh.scope_body: 股票或长期 Call 的亏损可能超过短 Call 收益。结合支撑资产回看短腿；部分策略结果仍不完整，缺项会在分析旁标明。
zh.p3_title:
跟随每笔交易，
看清成本与结果。
zh.p3_intro: 跟随未平仓、部分平仓与已平仓交易，查看记录支持的建仓成本、日期、剩余持仓和已实现结果。
measures: 把已实现结果与浮盈亏分开看。浮盈亏对应界面标注的保存报价和日期，不是实时行情。
查看纳入的交易腿、期间和成本依据。整笔交易回报需要完整的生命周期与充分的成本记录。
先看占资和效率指标覆盖哪些交易与日期。匹配子集不代表整个账户的回报；短 Call 收益也不代表完整 CC 或 PMCC 回报。
zh.p4_title:
带着你的问题，
从合成案例开始。
zh.p4_intro: Mac 预览套件提供合成券商文件和中英文指南，无需 Git、Python、Node、模型账号或 API Key。也可以先申请演示。
zh.support_title: 券商支持有明确的文件范围
zh.support_body: 支持 Moomoo、Chase / J.P. Morgan 投资账户与 E*TRADE 的特定美元 CSV 格式，兼容性取决于报告类型和历史记录。普通上传中的 statement PDF 仅归档，不会自动提取内容或完成对账。
zh.platform_title: Mac 预览，尚未广泛验证
zh.platform_body: 计划支持 Apple Silicon M1+ 和 macOS 15 / 26 / 27 正式版。目前仅在 macOS 15.2 开发机验证，含同机独立审阅；测试用户 Mac 尚待验证。临时签名，尚未公证；请勿为运行它关闭系统保护。
zh.personal: 先试合成案例。检查通过后，可按在线指南在独立新环境中本地试用个人数据。公开反馈不要附账户资料或券商原件。
zh.not_yet: 本版尚未提供：Windows、通用导入模板、通用 PDF 提取、实时行情或基于交易知识的管理指导。
zh.highlights_title: 可用产品，也是 AI 项目落地案例。
highlights: 设计股票和期权复盘流程，涵盖策略贡献、个股盈亏、交易成本与资金效率。
设计可扩展的分层数据模型，通过用户审阅与可追溯修正改善数据质量，支撑更多券商和分析。
通过专业 AI agents 协作完成实施、代码审阅、测试与发布，持续构建和迭代应用。
zh.terms: 持续开发中，计划采用专有 shareware 模式，价格和未来条款尚未公布。应用源码保持私有。预览试用遵循 Release 评估说明；本介绍材料不授予应用许可。
zh.screen_note: 当前公开版本的真实界面，全部使用合成演示数据。
